description: Precomputed theoretical hardware compute cost per 1M tokens (from Vast.ai & RunPod GPU rental + open-weight deployment throughput) compared against official non-cached API pricing. Returns min/median/provider scenarios, load_factor (default 0.70), API-to-compute ratio and gap (not gross margin), plus missing_reason for closed-source or oversized models.

gpu_model.description: Optional GPU id or name substring, e.g. h100, h200, b200

model_name.description: Optional model name or key substring, e.g. deepseek, qwen, glm-5

provider.description: Optional cloud provider substring, e.g. vast, runpod

name: get_token_production_economics
title: Token theoretical compute cost vs API price
